messages:
deploy-bot: :rocket: Staging deploy started for inference-runtime service — tag v2.1.8-rc4 (commit ab12c3d). Initiated by caroline. Canary: 10% traffic for 10m. Change window: 2026-03-20 02:00-03:00 UTC. Release notes: https://redwood-inference.internal/releases/v2.1.8-rc4
caroline: kicking off canary now. I'll watch healthchecks + logs. ping @rahul @ops_sre for infra watch.
rahul: watching retrier and reranker tails, have dashboards up. will call out any OOMs.
matt: quick note — left a short migration in the PR that toggles redis key TTLs, double-checking it won't run in staging since we flagged `run_migrations=false` in the deploy config.
ops_sre: confirmed migration flag is off in this deploy config. good to go.
sre-oncall-bot: [ALERT] 02:04 UTC — increased 503 rate detected on reranker-staging-3 (2.1% over baseline). Created incident INC-7291.
caroline: saw the spike, pausing traffic shift. can we pin traffic back to previous for that shard?
rahul: running quick rollback for reranker shard with `/deploy pin inference-runtime --to ab12c3c` (previous stable). applying now.
deploy-bot: Pin command accepted. Traffic for reranker-staging-3 rolled back to ab12c3c; canary traffic reduced to 0% on that host.
matt: logs show a transient dependency timeout to the reranker cache — looks like a connection pool exhaustion on that host. will recycle the host and bump pool size.
ops_sre: recycling host and increasing pool to 50 -> done. healthchecks passing on host after recycle.
rahul: reran smoke tests against pinned host. no 5xx now.
caroline: ok resuming canary and traffic shift slowly. will run 10% -> 30% -> 60% -> 100% with 5m holds.
deploy-bot: Traffic shifted to 30% (03:12 UTC). No new alerts.
sre-oncall-bot: note: brief spike on latency to embeddings service during the host recycle, resolved.
matt: confirmed latency back to baseline.
deploy-bot: Staging deploy completed — tag v2.1.8-rc4 rolled out to staging at 03:18 UTC. Commit ab12c3d. No rollback required. CI smoke: passed.
caroline: adding a short post-deploy note to the release thread — we hit a connection pool edge case during canary on one host; fix: bump pool size + ensure migration flag respected in deploy config. I'll add to release notes and schedule a follow-up to tweak autoscaling thresholds.
rahul: will open a small follow-up PR to add a healthcheck retry backoff, link: https://git.redwood-inference/internal/pr/4821
matt: thumbs up. thanks all for fast responses. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Kudos: :tada: All checks green. Marking deploy run as completed.
thread_summary: Staging deploy start -> canary hit 503 spike on one host -> traffic pinned and host recycled -> resume canary -> deploy completed. Post-deploy follow-up items tracked.
